summary:
[  edit  ]
The Perform  CHOP  outputs many channels like frames-per-second, describing the current state of the TouchDesigner process. As channels they can be manipulated into user interfaces and calculations to adjust real-time self-tuning of the process.
It outputs the "cook time" of the prior frame that was drawn, which is a reflection of how many frames TouchDesigner cooked in the prior second. The  cook
Tip : Put a Trail  CHOP  after the Perform  CHOP  to watch its progress.
channel, when sent to a Trail  CHOP  shows which frames were cooked and which were skipped, useful in optimizing your work to reach a desired frame rate.
The Built-in Variables found on Dialogs -> Variables -> Built-in include more useful data on your running system. See also the Built-in Variables section of the  Variables  page.

parameters.label: Frames per Second
parameters.name: fps
parameters.description: The number of frames rendered in the last second.

parameters.label: Frame Time
parameters.name: msec
parameters.description: Amount of time each frame takes to cook in msec.

parameters.label: Cook
parameters.name: cook
parameters.description: Is equal to 1 when a frame is cooked and equal to 0 when a frame is skipped.  It is often useful to view this channel in a  Trail CHOP  to see when frames are skipped (dropped).

parameters.label: Dropped Frames
parameters.name: droppedframes
parameters.description: The number of frames dropped between the last frame and the current frame.

parameters.label: Movie Read Ahead Misses
parameters.name: mvreadahead
parameters.description: How many times the movie read ahead failed to maintain the number of specified Read Ahead frames.

parameters.label: GPU  Mem Used (MB)
parameters.name: gpumemused
parameters.description: Amount of  GPU  memory used (in megabytes).

parameters.label: Total  GPU  Mem (MB)
parameters.name: totalgpumem
parameters.description: Total amount of  GPU  memory available on the system (in megabytes).

parameters.label: Total Active OPs
parameters.name: activeops
parameters.description: How many OPs are actively cooking.

parameters.label: Total Deactivated OP Calls
parameters.name: deactivatedops
parameters.description: Number of calls to cook a component that has its  Cooking Flag  turned off.

parameters.label: Total OPs
parameters.name: totalops
parameters.description: Total number of OPs in the  .toe  file.

parameters.label: CPU Mem Used (MB)
parameters.name: cpumemused
parameters.description: Amount of CPU memory used (in megabytes).

parameters.label: Cook  State
parameters.name: cookstate
parameters.description: Monitors which frames actually cooked. Pass the Perform  CHOP  to a Trail  CHOP  to properly see the trail of frames that did and did not cook. (It appears as always 1 because the viewer is displaying only the current frame and not frames it missed.)

parameters.label: Cook  Realtime
parameters.name: cookrealtime
parameters.description: Monitors the state of the realtime flag, determining if TouchDesigner is running in realtime mode or not.

parameters.label: Cookrate
parameters.name: cookrate
parameters.description: The global target cook rate (frames per second) of the project. This is the frames per second of the root component,  root.time.rate , typically  60 , though due to frames taking too long to cook, the actual frames per second may be lower.

parameters.label: Time Slice  Step
parameters.name: timeslicestep
parameters.description: The number of frames that TouchDesigner stepped forward for the current cook. It's the length of the  Time Slice  in frames. It will be equal to 1 when the system is taking  1000/root.time.rate  msec or less to complete one frame (16.666 msec for a rate of 60).

parameters.label: Time Slice  Milliseconds
parameters.name: timeslicemsec
parameters.description: The length of the current  Time Slice  in milliseconds.

parameters.label: Perform Mode
parameters.name: performmode
parameters.description: Monitors the state of  Perform Mode .

parameters.label: Perform  Window  Focus
parameters.name: performfocus
parameters.description: Monitors if the Perform  Window  currently has focus or not.

parameters.label: GPU  Temperature (Slow)
parameters.name: gputemp
parameters.description: Monitors the temperature of the system's GPUs, only works for NVIDIA GPUs.

parameters.label: AC Line Status
parameters.name: aclinestatus
parameters.description: Indicates if the laptop's AC Charger is plugged in and active. 1 if AC line is detected, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: Battery Charging
parameters.name: batterycharging
parameters.description: Indicates if the battery is being charged. 1 if charging, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: Battery Life
parameters.name: batterylife
parameters.description: Indicated charge remaining in battery, 1 is battery full, 0 is battery empty.

parameters.label: Battery Time

parameters.description: Estimated time remaining in battery charge. Only works if AC Line is disconnected and battery is not being charged.

localNotes.excerpt: # Skills especializados (currícula) Skills agregados/propuestos en `touchdesigner/skills/`: - `td-fundamentals`: fundamentos y convenciones reproducibles. - `td-project-architecture`: arquitectura de proyectos complejos y contratos. - `td-performance`: presupuestos y profiling. - `td-pops-advanced`: POPs avanzados + consulta técnica con `td_pops_query`. - `td-integration`: integración POP↔SOP/TOP/CHOP/DAT y render/instancing. - `td-robust-systems`: idempotencia, validación y reportes. ## Estructura recomendada por skill - Objetivo - Herramientas disponibles - Reglas / checklist - Plantilla de respuesta - Validaciones y pruebas (smoke tests)

# Prompts maestros (catálogo) Los prompts se almacenan como Markdown con frontmatter YAML en: - `prompts/master/*.md` ## Campos mínimos recomendados - `id`, `title` - `project_type`: particulas | efectos_visuales | generativos | interactivos - `complexity`: basico | intermedio | avanzado | experto - `application`: instalaciones | performances | visualizacion_datos - `touchdesigner_min_version` - `hardware` (GPU/VRAM mínimo cuando aplique) - `performance` (fps objetivo y presupuesto por frame) - `validation[]` (criterios verificables) ## Convenciones de salida Todo prompt maestro debe pedir explícitamente: - Script Python para `td_execute` (idempotente). - Validación Python posterior (existencia de OPs, conexiones críticas). - Declaración de presupuesto de rendimiento (puntos, cooks críticos).

# Detailed Investigation into POPs in TouchDesigner This investigation explores Point Operators (POPs), a new GPU-accelerated operator family in TouchDesigner, to prepare for an informative workshop. POPs create and modify 3D data, replacing the older SOPs (Surface Operators) with enhanced performance and flexibility. ## 1. What are POPs? - **Definition**: POPs (Point Operators) are a family of operators in TouchDesigner that run on the GPU, leveraging high parallelism to create and manipulate 3D data efficiently. - **Purpose**: They generate and modify points, primitives, and attributes for rendering (via Render TOP) or output to external devices like LED arrays or lasers. - **Significance**: POPs replace SOPs with GPU acceleration, memory optimization, and integration with modern work
